ios.desc:
Dashlane is more than just a password manager. It's automated protection that stays on guard, so you don't have to. Dashlane actively monitors for password leaks and scams so you can browse with total confidence. Whether you're at home or on the go, it provides worry-free access to your accounts anywhere you need it.

Trusted and recognized: PCWorld 2025 "Best Password Manager," PC Mag "Editors' Choice Award," Webby Award "People's Voice Best Mobile Services & Utilities App," Kiplinger's "Best Identity Theft Prevention Tools," Inc.com's "Best for Passwords and Checkouts," and Techlicious "The Best Security Apps."

Get effortless and secure password management

- Skip the typing: Dashlane identifies and instantly fills your saved logins, credit cards, and sensitive personal info, including driver's licenses and government IDs, across apps and browsers. You can even securely store and access your Wi-Fi network details in an instant.

- Get alerted when your data is involved in a breach: We scan the dark web for your data and alert you if your information is found in a leak.

- Take control of your password health: Track your security status with a personalized Password Health score and get actionable steps to strengthen weak, reused, or compromised passwords.

- Avoid getting locked out: Sync your passwords, passkeys, and personal info across an unlimited number of devices and operating systems.

- Stay organized: Group your logins and data into custom categories with Collections.

- Share safely: Effortlessly share passwords and Secure Notes with family or friends without exposing your credentials.

- Generate new passwords effortlessly: Create and save unique, random, and complex passwords for every account in a single tap with Dashlane's built-in Password Generator.

- Keep your most important files handy: Securely encrypt and store important documents, IDs, and receipts directly within your Secure Notes.

- Simplify your security: Generate and easily find your OTP (one-time password) and 2FA codes directly within Dashlane for all your 2FA-protected accounts.

Stay protected, without staying on high alert

- Get personalized security recommendations: "For You" is a dedicated space for security advice and actionable steps tailored to your digital footprint.
